symptom: A Studio Pro-resized activity or decision (ActionActivity 260;90, ExclusiveSplit 220;120) described with no size and MDL had no annotation for it, so drop + create from the description reset every box to 120x60 / 90x60 and a generated flow could not be sized. Once @size was written, a changed @size in `create or modify` still reported Unchanged.
cause: @size was parsed into ActivityAnnotations.Size but only loops and merges read it; describe printed it only for loops. In place, three gates hid a size change: builtAsStored's comparison up to layout sets an object's Size aside when the script states no position for it, sameExceptPositions treated Size as a difference that sent the pair to a gap that redraws nothing, and moved() read the left-over Size as 'a node inside the Log is moved'.
fix: The builder sets Size on ActionActivity / ExclusiveSplit / InheritanceSplit from @size; describe prints @size for a box that is not the builder's default, independent of whether the position is derived. In place, Size counts as a node-placement field like Position: movedNode records a Resize (a new mutator op that keeps the centre) or, for a loop, fitLoop; a stated @size is compared even when the position is the layout pass's.
insight: An annotation's write path is three paths: create, describe, and the in-place splice — and the splice has gates (built-as-stored, the LCS pairing modes, moved()) that each have a list of geometry fields. A new geometry field has to be added to each, or the splice reports Unchanged over a real change. A test that only does drop + create proves the first two.
test: mdl/executor/flowlayout_size_test.go TestSizeAnnotationOnActivitiesAndSplits_2589 (written, printed only for non-default boxes, drop + create from the description keeps the geometry) and TestSizeAnnotationResizesInPlace_2589 (a changed @size resizes only that box; control: a script without @size keeps the stored box). Both failed before the fix: sizes not written; then 'Unchanged'; then MDL-V1-REBUILD 'a node inside the Log is moved'.
